why: A method called on an object of its class links to it (MATLAB doc 'Method Invocation'; matlab-resolution.test.ts). Made `Access = private`, the call from outside the class errors in MATLAB (doc 'Method Attributes'), and made `Abstract`, the class can no longer be constructed (doc 'Abstract Classes and Class Members'). No resolution reads either attribute today, so a sync's definition delta leaves both out (step 13), and the override synthesizer, which reads `Access = private`, is redone on every MATLAB sync. This case guards that each step still ends where a fresh index ends (project rule), the subclass's override among it: once resolution reads either attribute, a sync that does not put the method's name in its delta keeps the old edge and this case fails.

known.what: While `area` is private or abstract the call from `user.m` still links to it.
known.why: The resolver does not read `Access` or `Abstract`: a resolution rule, for step 15.
